---
title: "Bagging with Hyperparameter Tuning"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# load it
library(randomForest)
library(caret)  
library(readr) 
train <- read_csv("~/Desktop/Stat Learning/Final Project/train.csv")
test <- read_csv("~/Desktop/Stat Learning/Final Project/test.csv")
# convert data to avoid annoying error
train$Y <- as.factor(train$Y)
```

```{r}
# 5-fold cross validation
set.seed(1)
folds <- createFolds(train$Y, k = 5, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)

# hyperparameter grid
# nodesize: Min samples per leaf (prevents overfitting)
# maxnodes: Max terminal nodes (limits depth/complexity)
hyper_grid <- expand.grid(
  nodesize = c(150, 175, 200, 225, 250, 275, 300, 325, 350, 375, 400, 425, 450),
  maxnodes = c(150, 175, 200, 225, 250, 275, 300, 325, 350, 375, 400, 425, 450) 
)

results <- data.frame(nodesize = integer(), maxnodes = character(), avg_f1 = double(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (row in 1:nrow(hyper_grid)) {
  
  current_ns <- hyper_grid$nodesize[row]
  current_mn <- hyper_grid$maxnodes[row] 
  f1_scores <- c() 
  
  for (i in 1:5) {
    # define cross validation and training sets
    val_idx <- folds[[i]]
    train_fold <- train[-val_idx, ]
    val_fold <- train[val_idx, ]
    
    # train the model
    model <- randomForest(Y ~ ., data = train_fold, mtry = 10, nodesize = current_ns, maxnodes = current_mn, ntree = 100)
    
    # probabilities used instead for threshold tuning later
    prob_preds <- predict(model, newdata = val_fold, type = "prob")[, "1"]
    
    # now optimize the threshold
    best_fold_f1 <- 0
    thresholds <- seq(0.1, 0.5, by = 0.05)
    actual_numeric <- ifelse(val_fold$Y == "1", 1, 0)
    
    for (thresh in thresholds) {
      pred_numeric <- ifelse(prob_preds > thresh, 1, 0)
      # do it manually to avoid slowdown and crashing with confusion matrix
      tp <- sum(pred_numeric == 1 & actual_numeric == 1)
      fp <- sum(pred_numeric == 1 & actual_numeric == 0)
      fn <- sum(pred_numeric == 0 & actual_numeric == 1)
      
      prec <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else 0
      rec  <- if ((tp + fn) > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else 0
      
      f1 <- 0
      if ((prec + rec) > 0) {f1 <- (2*prec*rec) / (prec+rec)}
      
      if (f1 > best_fold_f1) best_fold_f1 <- f1 
    }
    
    f1_scores <- c(f1_scores, best_fold_f1)
  }
  
  avg_f1 <- mean(f1_scores)
  cat(paste("Nodesize:", current_ns, "| MaxNodes:", current_mn, "- Avg F1:", round(avg_f1, 4), "\n"))
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(nodesize = current_ns, maxnodes = current_mn, avg_f1 = avg_f1))
}

# select best parameters
best_row_idx <- which.max(results$avg_f1)
best_ns <- results$nodesize[best_row_idx]
best_mn <- results$maxnodes[best_row_idx]

print(paste("Best Configuration Found -> Nodesize:", best_ns, "MaxNodes:", best_mn))

# retrain on ALL the data now and make more trees for robustness
set.seed(1)
final_model <- randomForest(Y ~ ., data = train, mtry = 10, nodesize = best_ns, maxnodes = best_mn, ntree = 500)
```

```{r}
# find the out of bag probabilities 
set.seed(1)
oob_probs <- predict(final_model, type = "prob")[, "1"]

max_oob_f1 <- 0
best_threshold <- 0
fine_thresholds <- seq(0.001, 0.5, by = 0.001)

# store actual results to compare and tune the threshold from OOB
actuals <- train$Y 

for (thresh in fine_thresholds) {
  pred_class <- ifelse(oob_probs > thresh, 1, 0)
  
  # manual calculation to avoid crashing
  tp <- sum(pred_class == 1 & actuals == 1)
  fp <- sum(pred_class == 1 & actuals == 0)
  fn <- sum(pred_class == 0 & actuals == 1)
  prec <- if((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else 0
  rec  <- if((tp + fn) > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else 0
  
  f1 <- 0
  if((prec + rec) > 0) f1 <- (2 * prec * rec) / (prec + rec)
  
  if (f1 > max_oob_f1) {
    max_oob_f1 <- f1
    best_threshold <- thresh
  }
}

print(paste("Optimal Threshold:", best_threshold, "with OOB F1:", round(max_oob_f1,4)))
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
# predict on test data as probability
final_probs <- predict(final_model, newdata = test, type = "prob")[, "1"]

# apply found optimal threshold to become logical 
final_preds <- ifelse(final_probs > best_threshold, 1, 0)

# export data to desktop
submission <- data.frame(ID = test$ID, Y = final_preds)
write.csv(submission, "~/Desktop/Bagging_submission.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# reality check (proportion default should be around 2-3%)
prop_ones <- mean(submission$Y)
print(paste("Proportion of 1s in submission:", round(prop_ones,4)))
```
